name: St. George Dry Rye Reposado Gin
official_name: St. George Dry Rye Reposado Gin
production: Built on St. George Dry Rye Gin (rye base, juniper-led)
Rested more than a year in French and American oak wine casks
Casks previously held Grenache rosé, Syrah and Tannat, from Blacksmith Cellars
history: Relaunched later in 26 US states at $50/750 ml (MarketWatch, date not stated)
expressions: St. George Dry Rye Gin | unaged base
serve_official: Rye-style cocktails: Old Fashioned, Manhattan, Hanky Panky, Martinez; pairs with sherry, umeshu or ginger
notes: Copper-pink hue. Cask source Blacksmith Cellars is run by winemaker Matt Smith, brother of head distiller Dave Smith.
